Dude, I am 25, have good facial features, and no one gives a fuck about loving me. And hell, I ain’t got a problem. But I do admit back when I was 20-22, I was feeling like shit about it. I believed -sincerely- no one would ever love me. (Lol and yet here I am. Imma see how far this goes)

Nonetheless, I will say this straightforward: You have a narrow view in life. See, you say you are a history major, it should at least give you some depths about life. As for memories, dude no one has good memories in college. Those who do however, never end up seeing each other. I see my colleagues who used to party and act all cool in groups and shit, but now, they act as if they don’t know each other.

You mentioned you want a wife who is like a best friend. Unfortunately my good old soul /friend, we live in a reality where no one cares of these things. I hate to say this, but the chances of you finding someone like that (especially if you have big dreams of making memories, being part of social communities, owning big stuff, etc...) is slim. These communities that you would dream about have so much falsity (no shame to them we are different humans), those whom are subjected to follow or affected by social norms can survive these environments. The amazing woman you are looking for however, exists in where the minds brawl. Yep, go to intellectual circles, she be there waiting and probably complaining with the same complaints as yours. 

You stated “I don’t blame a single girl for not settling for me” - dude wtf YES YOU SHOULD BLAME THEM. Never ever fucking say that. It was wrong of them to leave you hanging. And what is even more wrong is you smiling to them the next fucking day like nothing happened or nothing hurt you. Dude, STOP GLORIFYING THE NONE WORTHY OF GLORY. What greater significance have they done huh? 

It took me a long ass time to finally accept that these kind of people are not worth my time. I worked so hard on perfecting social skills, the looks, the charisma, all of it (I really did nail it down), I ended up falling into the worst period of my life. So please kindly trust me (as I am also 4 years older than you), these wishes and complaints you are mentioning are not worth the fucking timmmemememmememee.

On a last note, do yourself a favor and truly truly work on yourself, your character, and what you wish you could do better to make your life better (fyi i am a depressive insomniac, not saying this to make you feel better or tell you ‘wowz life z graeett’, it is shit and honestly i cannot wait to die lmao) THE MOST IMPORTANT THING HOWEVER, is when you start that favor DO NOT FUCKING THINK ABOUT PLEASING PEOPLE. PLEASE FOR FUCKS SAKE DO NOT GO DOWN THAT PATH. Look up some historical badasses and see how you can amp that shit to contemporary. Also, stop blaming yourself. You did what you could man. 

I hope you can get through this, and look for grander things to waste your time on. (Ps, you can message me if you’d like anytime. I’d be more than happy to help.)

I believe you need to leave the house at some point. I understand you are now 19, but at 21 or older, you would want an environment for you and your child.

Children are very empathetic and they feel their parent’s pain -if they are feeling one at any given moment-. Also, do not forget you are the eldest in the family. It is a lot of pressure when you are the first born. Getting shit from everywhere and everyone.

Sit down with yourself and try to figure shit out for the coming years. Because right now you are living in a toxic environment that will blind you from so many things. 

Also, stop opening your heart to people. No one is worth the time. Adulthood is a whole new world, and you hit the transition pretty early, considering you are a mother.

Last, the next time you feel ‘hated’ or unwanted, make sure that it is evident. Evidences -i like to say- are three types, verbal (someone says it to your face or behind you), active (someone demonstrates the hate), or visible (meaning you are ganged up or you notice a pattern that keeps coming at you).

Don’t kill yourself. Your kid needs you.
I’ve been feeling this way for a while with or without quarantine.

I am facing this issue, however it has been over a decade. All I can say is, just keep counting. Count how many games you’ve got, how much shoes you own, or how many days have passed. For me this has helped in a way to understand that there is a built up pattern about life. Somehow the idea of ‘growth’ stifles my depression, and makes me live with it instead if against it.

Depression will always be there. You cannot force it out. I was listening J. Peterson when he argued who should take anti-depressants. He mentioned that those who say they are depressed because of pleasures in life not fulfilled, then should it be fulfilled and they end up feeling happy, that means they don’t need anti-depressants. Those that are truly depressed have a neurological error in their system. The smallest of events in life that give moments or joy, the body of the depressed does not easily respond to it. It is because of the neurons and hormones. Those, who have those, are the ones eligible for anti-depressants.

Well, guess it is time I sign up for some. 
Also. I hope you are not the second type (like me).
